scope: Focused adversarial primary-literature novelty review, no numerical production

sources.authors: Timothy Kusalik; James A. Mingo; Roland Speicher
sources.title: Orthogonal Polynomials and Fluctuations of Random Matrices
sources.inspection_depth: Bibliography and abstract; compared with existing checkpoint derivation
sources.comparison: Established annular Wishart diagrams and Chebyshev diagonalization; no physical ZZ entropy result identified.

sources.title: CLT for spectra of submatrices of Wigner random matrices II. Stochastic evolution
sources.comparison: Temporal Wigner mode covariance already equals powers of entry correlation. Different matrix ensemble.

sources.title: Three-dimensional Gaussian fluctuations of spectra of overlapping stochastic Wishart matrices
sources.inspection_depth: Full text, setup, Theorem 1.1 and proof
sources.comparison: Very close temporal Wishart Gaussian field; homogeneous entry-time correlations, not sector-dependent ZZ phases.

sources.authors: Olga Friesen; Matthias Löwe; Michael Stolz
sources.title: Gaussian Fluctuations for Sample Covariance Matrices with Dependent Data
sources.comparison: Dependence-weighted polynomial covariance is established. Not asserted as a direct theorem for the time-indexed phase model.

sources.title: On the regularity conditions in the CLT for the LUE
sources.inspection_depth: Introduction and main results; compared with checkpoint assumption check
sources.comparison: Source of variance convergence and low-regularity marginal approximation; not new here.

sources.authors: Jordan Cotler; Nicholas Hunter-Jones; Daniel Ranard
sources.title: Fluctuations of subsystem entropies at late times
sources.inspection_depth: Main text, theorem statements, Haar appendix scope
sources.comparison: Entropy-deficit rarity and suppression after equilibration, not this stationary balanced-cut lag covariance.

sources.authors: Lih-King Lim; Cunzhong Lou; Chushun Tian
sources.title: Mesoscopic fluctuations in entanglement dynamics
sources.inspection_depth: Main text and relevant supplementary variance and phase-gradient sections
sources.comparison: Closest broad physics framing; temporal fluctuations and Renyi extensions already studied in lattice dynamics.

sources.title: Distribution of the entanglement entropies of non-ergodic quantum states
sources.comparison: Distribution-level complexity evolution differs from a coherent physical two-time trajectory.

sources.authors: Celine Nadal; Satya N. Majumdar; Massimo Vergassola
sources.title: Statistical distribution of quantum entanglement for a random bipartite state
sources.comparison: Static random bipartite entropy statistics and large deviations; no strong absence claim about full text.

sources.authors: Paolo Zanardi; Christof Zalka; Lara Faoro
sources.title: On the Entangling Power of Quantum Evolutions
sources.inspection_depth: Full relevant definitions and product-state average formulas
sources.comparison: Mean linear entropy generated on product inputs, not equilibrium same-input entropy covariance.

sources.title: Entanglement of Quantum Evolutions
sources.comparison: Operator entanglement and its connection to entangling power are established.

sources.authors: Georgios Styliaris; Namit Anand; Paolo Zanardi
sources.title: Information Scrambling over Bipartitions: Equilibration, Entropy Production, and Typicality
sources.comparison: Bipartite OTOC equals linear operator entanglement; no checked all-order Haar-state entropy autocovariance statement.

sources.title: Page Curve for Local-Operator Entanglement from Free Probability
sources.inspection_depth: v1 relevant full text and Appendix D; current v2 abstract
sources.comparison: Late-time Haar Heisenberg-operator entropy and annealed-average fluctuation control. Different from state entropy temporal memory.

sources.title: Spectral Small-Incremental-Entangling: Breaking Quasi-Polynomial Complexity Barriers in Long-Range Interacting Systems
sources.inspection_depth: Current abstract; detailed distinction inherited from checkpoint prior-art audit
sources.comparison: Worst-case Renyi rate threshold alpha=1/2. No improvement or contradiction is claimed.

sources.authors: Shi-Xin Zhang; Shuo Liu; Yu-Qin Chen
sources.title: Entanglement Growth as Transport Across Schmidt Scales
sources.comparison: Schmidt-scale transport and event hierarchy; warns against generic spectrum-beyond-entropy framing.

review_inferences.claim: A standard smooth scalar Gaussian interpolation has the same low-order 8 alpha increment exponent and quarter-order threshold after the same entropy approximation.
review_inferences.status: Reviewer analytical comparison, not located as a published entanglement statement

review_inferences.claim: For ZZ, F_k is the kth power sum of normalized squared operator-Schmidt coefficients.
review_inferences.status: Elementary identity; no arbitrary-gate extension asserted

review_inferences.claim: Checkpoint05 Renyi-2 limiting increment variance 1-F_2 equals linear operator entanglement and the established bipartite OTOC for ZZ.
review_inferences.status: Derived identity, not a new definition or independent diagnostic
Non-exhaustive screening conclusion, not originality certification

review_inferences.claim: An isospectral equal-initial-strength gate control can illustrate ordinary-order finite-time entropy memory differences, but the all-order covariance relation must carry novelty rather than a familiar operator-entanglement difference.
review_inferences.status: Conditional conceptual assessment; construction and generalized theorem not independently audited by this reviewer
